design.claims: Same finite regression targets and same complete primitive+four-certified-lemma inventory. No RL, novel theorem, universal palette, full PA or full Hilbert geometry claim. Eager/indexed graph caches may differ; current legal domains, point solution semantics, scheduling and exact rollback must agree. Every successful new proof must pass independent host checker at coarse and expanded original levels. Historical native C1 checks do not count as fresh checks.

assessment: The exact index removes materialization overhead by using the same problem-defining marking equalities earlier. It does not discover a new marking, a learned cluster family or an RL policy.
The conventional control searches producers by output formula and remaining depth. This single finite regression comparison does not establish a broad advantage over automated theorem provers.

Rooted proof-tree reachability is required; arbitrary disconnected point packings are not proof certificates. Full first-order expressiveness in a single fixed tile set and useful learned hierarchies remain open.

coarse_host_check.scope: Derivability from exactly supplied closed finite theory axioms in classical one-sorted FOL with equality. No theory-membership, consistency, automatic-discovery, typed-geometry, or Wang claim.

costs.scope: Complete input validation, copies, canonical hashes, transformation reconstruction and output preparation; no logical kernel or caller serialization.

lowering_audit.scope: Complete exact bank/pruning/extension/splice associations; not a replacement for native C1 plus independent B original-theory logical verification.

original_host_check.scope: Derivability from exactly supplied closed finite theory axioms in classical one-sorted FOL with equality. No theory-membership, consistency, automatic-discovery, typed-geometry, or Wang claim.

costs.scope: Own validation/copy/index/search/proof/return preparation; caller serialization excluded. Cooperative, no OS quota.

tree_audit.scope: Exact finite anchored binary proof-tree adaptation, integer capacity 2 and root seed 1. Complete structural MP/GEN/zero identities are checked; the declared catalogue and non-axiom zero logical truth additionally need current independent catalogue/schema assurance. All positive native proofs need unchanged C1 and independent B, and original-theory lowering when lemmas are imported. No infinite tiling, fixed translation palette, unrestricted FOL negative or equality of tree/DAG/primitive bounds.
